exposure: failed trial of labor to cesarean section
cohort: The study included 124 neonates diagnosed with perinatal cerebral infarction (PCI) admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) between June 2015 and December 2023.
finding: Perinatal arterial ischemic stroke (PAIS) was found to be more prevalent than perinatal hemorrhagic stroke (PHS), with a notable correlation between failed labor trials resulting in cesarean sections and PAIS, while postnatal thrombocytopenia was significantly associated with PHS.
mod_finding: A higher rate of conversion from failed trial of labor to cesarean section was significantly associated with the PAIS group compared to the PHS group.
